scientific_question: Does raw M5 fail as a rotation surrogate, or does it require mathematically justified rotation-aware normalization?

minimal_component_replay.reason: Existing scalar artifacts do not preserve M5 primitive components, per-token per-layer values, denominators, or head localization.
minimal_component_replay.semantics: Reuse the frozen prior BatchedMechanismPatch recurrent implementation and C128 QDQ; add observation-only norm hooks. Prefill is unquantized and generated tokens are replayed deterministically with QDQ after each token.
minimal_component_replay.full_formal_replay: all 60 existing trajectories, no sampling, no logits or generated text saved

parity_gate.sample_selection: canonical source row 0, first 128 generated tokens

fp_equivalent_coordinate_audit.selection_basis: fixed canonical indices, chosen before outcomes are joined
fp_equivalent_coordinate_audit.interpretation: M5 is evaluated only as the same frozen functional map applied to finite-precision FP-equivalence residual E. No synthetic nonzero M5 reference is constructed.
fp_equivalent_coordinate_audit.coordinate_residual_gate: For a candidate metric, the Hadamard FP-equivalent residual p95 must be <=1% of the Hadamard INT8 p95 on the same audit token/layer points; otherwise coordinate sanity fails.
fp_equivalent_coordinate_audit.identity_expected: zero up to deterministic arithmetic identity

raw_M5.definition: Existing canonical/recovered-basis ||W_O D_g D_w J_RMS(o) E^T q||_2.

M5_canonical.definition: The existing M5 after Hadamard state error is strictly pulled back by H128 into the native FP state basis before E^T q; FP q, RMS point, gate, norm weight and W_O are shared.
M5_canonical.transformation_proof_obligation: H128 is orthogonal and symmetric; S_native=H128*S_rotated and q_rotated=q_native*H128 preserve q*S readout in exact arithmetic.
M5_canonical.expected_relation: Algebraically identical to the existing implementation; retained to test whether the prior raw metric was already canonical.

Delta_M5.definition: M5_INT8,R - M5_reference,R only if a definition-consistent reference error exists.
Delta_M5.applicability_rule: The exact FP-vs-self error is zero, so Delta_M5 reduces identically to M5_canonical and is not treated as an independent candidate. If a nonzero rotation-specific baseline would be required, classify NOT_APPLICABLE rather than invent it.

relative_M5_reference.applicability_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when the mathematically valid reference is exactly zero or the empirical finite-precision residual is near-zero/unstable.

FP_signal_normalized_M5.meaning: Functional error relative to the native FP linear-attention output signal scale at the same token and layer.
FP_signal_normalized_M5.denominator_source: single shared FP row, never estimated separately per rotation
FP_signal_normalized_M5.denominator_pathology_rule: Report fractions below 1e-8, 1e-6 and 1e-4 and all quantiles; fail coordinate sanity if more than 1% are below 1e-8 or if the metric tail is demonstrably denominator-controlled.

M5_over_M0.definition: M5_canonical/(M0_canonical+1e-12) at the same token and layer.
M5_over_M0.role: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY unless every gate passes; cancellation of a common scale is not itself functional validation.

trajectory.mean: mean over all finite token-layer observations
trajectory.p95: linear 95th percentile over all finite token-layer observations

aggregation.candidate_primary: median of clean59 trajectory p95 values

gate_definitions.coordinate_sanity: FP-equivalent residual gate passes and no unexplained rotation-specific denominator pathology.
gate_definitions.within_rotation: For both Identity and Hadamard on the FP-correct panel, failure AUROC point estimate >0.50 and median risk(failure)>median risk(correct); bootstrap CIs and effect sizes are reported but are not required to exclude 0.50.
gate_definitions.pairwise_direction: On clean59, median trajectory p95(Hadamard) < median trajectory p95(Identity). This is only PAIRWISE_DIRECTION_CHECK.
gate_definitions.rescue_association: P(delta_risk<0) in Hadamard-rescue >0.50, rescue median delta < stable-failure median delta, Cliff's delta(rescue,stable-failure)<0, and one-sided label-permutation p<0.10.

decision_rule.PASS: At least one rotation-aware variant passes all four gates.
decision_rule.FAIL: Every mathematically reasonable rotation-aware variant fails at least one required gate.
decision_rule.on_PASS: Stop before persistent KL replay and report.
decision_rule.on_FAIL: Report failure, then the separately preserved persistent pipeline may be resumed only in a later execution step. This task itself stops after the report.
